overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on any of the three allegations: the email-drafted document, the chair's email contacts with an alternate, and an off-notice topic that was not discussed. It issued only a cautionary note on circulating documents.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged members deliberated by email outside a posted meeting while drafting a document on commissioner duties and qualifications, then circulated it.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair's email communications with an alternate member about the drafted document were an unlawful deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the discussion about the document between the Chair and Mr. Feist did not reach a quorum.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair raised a topic not listed on the July 6, 2011 meeting notice, namely a prior decision on replacement windows at a historic property.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Commission did not discuss the topic, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
